## Side Effect Isolation

All side effects (I/O, network, database, filesystem) must be isolated at system boundaries:

- Pure business logic must not depend on external services directly
- Side-effectful operations are pushed to the edges of the system
- Use dependency injection or explicit parameter passing to provide external dependencies
- Test pure logic without mocks; mock only at system boundaries

## Configuration Format Preferences

- Use **KDL** for application configuration (settings, keybindings, preferences)
- Use **JSON** for content data, API contracts, and LLM-consumed formats
- Use environment variables for deployment-specific secrets and connection strings
